svg.text: A29 · Summing amplifier
Add signals with feedback
Post-16 · ages 16–19
Each input resistor contributes a current to the inverting input node.
Feedback converts the sum of those currents into an output voltage.
Your investigation
Predict the signed contribution of each input. Change one input at a time,
then compare the combined result.
This activity
Apply two independently adjustable inputs through different resistors.
Compare the measured output with a weighted sum, then investigate
clipping with a suitable model.
Getting started
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
Explain:
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
measurements.
